MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable feels useful because it could help connect my video equipment, and its 4K support fits my television setup.",
    "The Echo Show 5 interests me as a compact bedside display for viewing and controls alongside my Fire TV devices; it offers a different use from what I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Both recommended Fire TV Sticks duplicate what my existing 4K Stick already does, and an older or HD model gives me little reason to choose another.",
    "The tablet, earbuds and portable speaker do not address the home viewing and security needs behind my recent purchases.",
    "The memory cards might be useful, but I cannot choose them confidently without knowing whether their format and recording speed suit my camera."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Fire TV devices seems to have been taken as a reason to offer more Amazon devices, even when they serve purposes I have not shown interest in.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched to include general audio accessories, although my recent choices center on video and security."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: another streaming device needs to add a useful capability beyond my 4K Stick and Fire TV television.",
    "Accessories feel relevant when they meet a specific connection or recording need and are compatible with my equipment.",
    "A device with a screen appeals to me for viewing and controls in a way that a voice-only speaker does not."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my home electronics interests but missed the difference between useful additions and devices that duplicate my setup or serve unrelated needs."
}
